title: AuditEvent
description: Schema for audit events appended to the tamper-evident audit log. Per arch v2 §8.x. Event type naming per naming.md §7 = `<noun>.<past_verb>` snake_case (e.g. `tool.called` not `ToolCall`). Hash chain uses SHA-256 hex (64 chars) per TASK-013 design.

action.description: Tool name (for tool.* events) or internal action identifier.

target.description: TargetDescriptor if relevant (validated by tool's own schema).

args.description: Tool input args; redacted per ADR-0034.

scope_options.description: Present only when allow=true and human confirmation is required. Values follow arch v2 §10.3. Availability of this field is the single confirmation predicate; no separate requires_confirmation boolean is allowed (ADR-0048).

show_diff.description: Required when scope_options is present. true means the approval request must carry displayable diff data; false means no diff is required for this confirmation.

prev_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of previous event in chain. Empty string for the first event.

self_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of this event (computed over all fields except self_hash).
